scope: Docker Compose DAST interruption and Docker Desktop recovery attempt

dast.stateBeforeInterruption: Built isolated API/PostgreSQL image, migrations and seed completed; ZAP imported 35 OpenAPI URLs and started activeScan.
dast.runnerResult: Exit code 1; the scan did not create a pass report.
dast.cleanup: ZAP container removal timed out; docker compose down returned HTTP 500 from Docker Engine API /containers/json.
dast.volumePolicy: DAST_KEEP_VOLUMES=1; compose cleanup did not request --volumes. Current run-owned resource state could not be enumerated after Engine failure.

dockerDesktop.restart: docker desktop restart failed: processes remained running and the CLI reported context deadline exceeded.
dockerDesktop.start: docker desktop start --detach returned Starting Docker Desktop; a later foreground start reported Docker Desktop is already running.

latestObserved.dockerEngineApi: Unavailable or unresponsive; desktop status and engine queries did not return.
latestObserved.backendStartupError: Current backend.error.json/log repeats Windows error 1920 while initializing Ingest and removing %LOCALAPPDATA%/Docker/run/sailor-ingest.sock.

runtimeSocket.aclAndReparseQueries: Get-Acl and fsutil reparsepoint query fail with Windows error 1920. This supports a stale/inaccessible socket diagnosis; it does not establish VHDX corruption.

dockerDesktop.resourceObservationDuringScan: Windows reported 0.44 GB free physical memory before restart. This is correlated with the interruption but is not established as the root cause.
dockerDesktop.serviceStartAttempt: Start-Service com.docker.service was denied with Cannot open service; the current session lacks rights to control this service.

latestSecurityScanAttempt.result: Failed before scanning because the Docker Desktop Linux Engine named pipe was missing.
latestSecurityScanAttempt.scannerRequirement: scripts/scan-secrets.mjs runs pinned Gitleaks v8.30.1 as a Docker container; no standalone gitleaks executable is available on PATH.
latestSecurityScanAttempt.coverageCaveat: Earlier Gitleaks pass remains historical evidence and does not cover source/evidence files added after that scan.

requiredFollowup: Restore Docker Desktop Engine with sufficient Windows service privileges, verify existing Compose containers/volumes, then rerun Compose DAST only when host resources are adequate.
